description:
Modern JavaFX foundation for the iTech Framework, providing essential tools
        for building rich desktop interfaces. Core features include:
        - CSS-based styling architecture
        - MVVM pattern implementation support
        - Prebuilt material-inspired controls
        - Performance-optimized animation framework
        - Seamless Java 17+ integration (Records, sealed hierarchies, etc.)
        - Adaptive layout management system
        - Built-in dependency injection for controllers
        - Multi-threaded task management utilities
        - High-DPI/4K display support
        - Modular theme switching capabilities
        - Preference API for data storage

        Accelerates JavaFX development while maintaining framework consistency.
